summary: Parts-first automotive and heavy-machinery mode, an optional point-of-sale till with barcode scanning, and store settings in one CRM options tile, on DjangoLux 1.10.
highlights: Tag vehicles or machines while adding a part; search by part number; copy or bulk-assign fitments.
Heavy machinery: machine types, shared engines, and optional machine wording across the app.
Optional till: scan or search, most-sold grid, discounts, split cash/card/transfer, receipts.
Extra barcodes per item or size; the phone camera scans on iPhone too.
CRM options tile groups the products layout, public shop and till settings.
Exchange rates fetched through the Composer relay; the public shop follows the visitor's language.
Workspace quick actions and tiles for the till and the vehicle browser while they are on.
Requires DjangoLux 1.10.0; Composer 1.6.0 for relay-fetched exchange rates.
